Senses.Note: After the fifteenth day is the second half of Yunmen’s test: he refuses discussion of before the fifteenth and demands one line for after it. Later masters re-raise and alter this frame.

Occurrences.Kwic: 眾云：十五日以前即不問，十五日以後道將一句來。自云：日日是
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X67/X67n1307.xml). Wansong’s Comments on Tiantong’s Old Cases: Wansong Xingxiu bears the exact headword. Wansong raises Yunmen’s before-and-after case and comments on its self-answer.

Occurrences.Kwic: 曰：十五日以前不許動著，十五日以後道將一句。日日好日，太煞
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X82/X82n1571.xml). Complete Collection of the Five Lamps: Baiyun Zhidu bears the exact headword. Baiyun Zhidu repeats the demand for one line after the fifteenth.

Occurrences.Kwic: 日以前，人人頭上頂青天；十五日以後，目前法法皆仍舊。正當十
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J28/J28nB203.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yun’e: Yun'e Xi bears the exact headword. Yun’e Xi contrasts what stands before and after the fifteenth in his release-day address.

Occurrences.Kwic: 前，彷彷彿彿，神頭鬼面；十五日以後，依依稀稀，鬼面神頭。政
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J28/J28nB202.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baichi: Baichi Xingyuan directly deploys the after-the-fifteenth side of a three-part calendar test.

Senses.Explanation: After the fifteenth day is the second half of Yunmen’s fixed before-and-after test: he refuses discussion of before the fifteenth and demands one line for after it. Later masters re-raise and alter this calendrical frame. one half of Yunmen’s fixed before-and-after case: original demand and later reprises retain the calendar boundary After fixes the second side of the date boundary; the date alone can be ordinary calendrical prose. Before the fifteenth is the paired first half and every day is a good day is Yunmen’s self-answer, not a second sense.
